description: Automatonism Reloaded is a Pure Data abstraction library and fork of Johan Eriksson’s Automatonism modular synthesizer. It adds MIDI learn, in-patch state saving, PlugData/DAW integration, and is distributed through Deken under the name “automatonism.”

research.notes: The current Deken package named “automatonism” is Automatonism Reloaded. The original Automatonism project is distributed from its official website, where no canonical source repository or issue tracker is identified.
